default_error_the_kernel_tool_needs_the: ERROR: the kernel tool needs the {missing} package{plural}, which {verb} not importable in this environment. Install js[kernel], or run `uv sync --inexact --extra kernel` in this checkout. Enable it with `/set PYTHON_KERNEL on`. The extra is declared in pyproject.toml; `just sync` includes it for development, while `just install` creates the launcher. Every other tool is unaffected.
get_session_error_kernel_toolbox_disable: ERROR: kernel/toolbox disabled; use /set PYTHON_KERNEL on (requires js[kernel]).
died_error_the_kernel_died_during_execut: ERROR: the kernel died during execution (cell {cell}). Everything defined in this session is gone; call again with restart=true and rebuild.
busy_error_the_previous_cell_is_still: ERROR: the previous cell is still running ({live_first_line}); interrupt it or wait
busy_handle_action_poll_for_new_output: handle {live_id}: action="poll" for new output, action="interrupt" to stop it, action="wait" to block for it. A cell blocked in a syscall that ignores SIGINT needs restart=true
kernel_error_kernel_toolbox_disabled_use: ERROR: kernel/toolbox disabled; use /set PYTHON_KERNEL on (requires js[kernel]).
kernel_error_no_cell_nothing_to_poll: ERROR: no cell {value_0}; nothing to poll, interrupt, or wait for
kernel_interrupt_sent_to_cell_it_stopped: interrupt sent to cell {live_id}; it stopped ({live_age:.1f}s).
kernel_interrupt_sent_to_cell_it_is: interrupt sent to cell {live_id}; it is still running ({live_age:.1f}s).
kernel_interrupted_after_s_the_cell_was: INTERRUPTED after {limit:g}s. The cell was stopped with a KeyboardInterrupt; the namespace and everything defined in it are intact.
